WITH station_shares AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_above_average
  FROM station_shares
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_above_average
FROM scored
WHERE share_above_average > 0
ORDER BY share_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10
